attempts.why: Buttons had fixed 20px height with overflow:hidden and 8px padding causing text/icon to be vertically clipped; using min-height and visible overflow restores full label without hiding content.

selfVerify.reason: Buttons now render at 36px height (min-height, not fixed 20px) with overflow visible: cta/menu/tip/dd/dis/submit all show 36px height and icon/text fully inside bounds (e.g., #cta 130x36 contains icon 12x12 at y24 and text 78x19 at y20), no clipping. docScrollWidth 1200 == viewport 1200 so no horizontal overflow introduced, card/badge overflow remains visible as intended.
